Package com.kerosene.kfe.pricing.adapters.out.bitcoin

Record Class KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService.Estimate

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.pricing.adapters.out.bitcoin.KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService.Estimate
Record Components:
selectedNetworkFeeSats - network fee selected for pricing, in satoshis
selectedFeeRateSatPerVbyte - selected rate in sat/vbyte
selectedTargetBlocks - selected confirmation target
selectedEstimatedSeconds - estimated time for the selected target
selectedSource - source of the selected fee rate
estimatedVbytes - transaction size assumption used for fee calculation
expiresAt - time at which this estimate or its quote becomes stale
tiers - fast, standard, and slow fee options when the rail uses on-chain fees
Enclosing class:
KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService
public static record KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService.Estimate(long selectedNetworkFeeSats, long selectedFeeRateSatPerVbyte, int selectedTargetBlocks, long selectedEstimatedSeconds, String selectedSource, int estimatedVbytes, Instant expiresAt, List<KfeFeeTierResponse> tiers) extends Record
Selected standard fee estimate and available response tiers.
